title: Structural and theoretical investigations of a novel hexanuclear Lanthanum (III) cluster self-assembled through a functionalized β-diketone ligand via atmospheric CO2 fixation

material_class.structural_family: hexanuclear lanthanum oxo-hydroxo cluster templated by μ4-HCO3−

synthesis.procedure: HO-DBM and lanthanum trichloride hydrate were combined in 30 mL of methanol and stirred at room temperature for 10 min to give a clear solution. Triethylamine was added dropwise; a yellow precipitate formed during addition and stirring was continued for 12 h at room temperature. The precipitate was filtered, washed with 5 mL of methanol to remove excess triethylamine hydrochloride, and air-dried. X-ray quality crystals were grown from toluene/hexane. Atmospheric CO2 is described as the source of the bicarbonate template in basic medium.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred solution synthesis in air; crystallization from toluene/hexane
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow precipitate filtered, washed with 5 mL methanol, air-dried; X-ray quality crystals grown from toluene/hexane. Six lattice toluene molecules co-crystallize with the cluster.
